C1539.title: Drift Loses $285 Million in Durable Nonce Social Engineering Attack
C1539.summary: On April 1, 2026, the Drift protocol suffered a $285 million loss due to a social engineering attack exploiting nonce management. The attacker achieved admin account takeover through social engineering, exposing a pattern of cryptocurrency theft linked to North Korea.
